# KGNS

> KGNS is a Laredo, Texas-based news and weather station providing local forecasts, breaking news, and regional reporting.

KGNS covers weather, local incidents, and regional news stories affecting the Laredo and South Texas communities. The station emphasizes real-time weather updates and local emergency reporting.

## Key Topics

- Laredo, Texas
- Weather forecasts
- Local news
- Current conditions
- Hourly forecast
- Weekend forecast
- Fire weather
- U.S. Navy
- Military incidents
- San Diego Bay
- Helicopter operations
- Emergency response
- South Texas region

## Weather & Forecasts

- [Weather](https://www.kgns.tv/weather): KGNS weather forecasts and current conditions for Laredo, Texas

## Local News

- [Cop Car Involved In Crash On Springfield Avenue](https://www.kgns.tv/content/news/Cop-Car-Involved-In-Crash-On-Springfield--401397445.html): Police car crash on Springfield Avenue in south Laredo involving elderly driver
- [Thieves steal almost 10,000 gallons of gas as police warn about increase in thefts](https://www.kgns.tv/2022/05/04/thieves-steal-almost-10000-gallons-gas-police-warn-about-increase-thefts/): Las Vegas police warn of gas theft spike; nearly 10,000 gallons stolen

## Regional & National News

- [US Navy helicopter crew survives crash into bay in Southern California](https://www.kgns.tv/2024/01/12/us-navy-helicopter-crew-survives-crash-into-bay-southern-california/): MH-60R Seahawk crash in San Diego Bay; Navy crew survives incident
- [Prank calls to other players unrelated to the one received by Shedeur Sanders, source says](https://www.kgns.tv/2025/04/30/prank-calls-other-players-unrelated-one-received-by-shedeur-sanders-source-says/): NFL draft prank call to Shedeur Sanders unrelated to other incidents
